default.sentence: Every 21 trading days (about monthly), hold every one of these stocks, equally weighted.
default.headline: hold every one of these stocks

edited.sentence: Every 5 trading days (about weekly), hold the 2 stocks that rose most over the last 126 trading days, counting only those trading above their 200-day average, equally weighted; keep a holding while it stays in the top 3. Move everything to cash whenever the S&P 500 is below its 200-day average. If none qualify, the money waits in cash. The first decision waits for 200 trading days of history; until then it holds cash.
